lines.en: label otohadorm10:
scene noonsky
: What? Seriously?
lines.zh: : 什么？认真的吗？

lines.en: : Well, what are we supposed to do in the meantime then?
lines.zh: : 那这段时间我们该干点什么？

lines.en: Otoha and I are making our way to the cafe following her lesson, but I’m sure that’s about to change based on the apparent urgency of this phone call.
lines.zh: 下课后，我和 Otoha 正往咖啡馆走，但从这通电话的急迫程度来看，我敢肯定计划马上就要变了。

lines.en: : But what if he like, kidnaps me or something?
lines.zh: : 可万一他把我绑架了之类的怎么办？

lines.en: : Otoha, this way. I know a shortcut through a dark alley.
lines.zh: : Otoha，这边走。我知道一条穿过黑巷子的近路。

lines.en: : Oh my God, it’s literally about to happen. Help.
lines.zh: : 我的天，这事真要发生了。救命。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. It’s fine. We’ll just kill some time or whatever until you’re off.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。没事。我们就随便打发点时间，等你下班。

lines.en: : Okay. Talk to you later.
lines.zh: : 好。回头聊。

lines.en: : I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume that was Rin.
lines.zh: : 我斗胆猜一下，刚才那是 Rin 吧。

lines.en: : Yup. The cafe’s gotten way too busy for her to be able to chill with us, so she told us to “Save ourselves” and not bother coming.
lines.zh: : 嗯。咖啡馆太忙了，她没法陪我们，所以让我们“自求多福”，别过去了。

lines.en: : Looks like you and I will have to use this opportunity to bond, then.
lines.zh: : 那看来就剩我们俩利用这个机会好好联络感情了。

lines.en: : Guess so. But can we maybe cut back on the Rin stuff this time and talk about something more...fun?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过这次能不能少聊点 Rin，说点更……有趣的事？

lines.en: : I’m telling Rin you don’t think she’s fun.
lines.zh: : 我要去告诉 Rin，你觉得她没意思。

lines.en: : That’s obviously not what I mean. There’s just only so much drama I can handle before it becomes a burden.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是那个意思。只是我能承受的狗血剧情就那么多，再多就成了负担。

lines.en: : So if I have a chance to break away from that...I’m probably going to take it.
lines.zh: : 所以只要有机会摆脱这些……我大概都会抓住。

lines.en: scene black
We’ve reached the time of day where the sun begins to migrate to the opposite side of the globe.
lines.zh: 一天中太阳开始移向地球另一面的时刻到了。

lines.en: We follow its light, for it always sets behind the dorms.
lines.zh: 我们追着它的光走，因为它总是落在宿舍后面。

lines.en: And, before we know it, we’re there.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，我们就到了。

lines.en: We move away from the orange glow into a lobby brought to life by the welcome sensation of air conditioning, something that hasn’t been present here in quite some time.
lines.zh: 我们离开橙色的余晖，走进被空调的舒适感唤醒的门厅——这里的空调已经很久没开过了。

lines.en: The lack of windows makes it hard for air to properly circulate in here, so the difference in climate is noticed by both of us immediately.
lines.zh: 这里没有窗户，空气很难流通，所以我们俩立刻就感觉到了温差。

lines.en: We inhale deeply in unison, filling our lungs with the start of something we hope is wonderful.
lines.zh: 我们不约而同地深深吸气，让肺里充满某种我们希望会很美好的事物的开端。

lines.en: Our eyes meet for a moment.
lines.zh: 我们的目光短暂地交汇了一下。

lines.en: Otoha smirks.
lines.zh: Otoha 坏笑了一下。

lines.en: We go upstairs.
lines.zh: 我们上楼。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard1
: Okay, so...remember earlier when I said that Nodoka was going through another manic phase?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……还记得我之前说 Nodoka 又进入躁狂期了吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 记得。

lines.en: : FUCK! NO! EVERYTHING IS WRONG!
lines.zh: : 操！不！全都错了！

lines.en: : She sounds pretty normal to me.
lines.zh: : 我听着挺正常的啊。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. I guess destroying everything on her side of the room isn’t exactly {i}off brand{/i} for her, but we should still kinda tread lightly, you know?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。把她那半边房间全砸了倒也算不上{i}出格{/i}，不过我们还是小心点为好，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Don’t ignore her existence because then she’ll think she’s like, turned invisible or something. But don’t spend too much time staring at her either.
lines.zh: : 也别当她不存在，不然她会觉得自己隐形了之类的。但也别盯着她看太久。

lines.en: : Otoha, if you want me to pay more attention to you, all you have to do is ask.
lines.zh: : Otoha，想让我多关注你一点，开口说就行了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard2
: Noted. Opening the door now. Brace for impact.
lines.zh: : 记住了。现在开门。准备迎接冲击。

lines.en: scene black
: Nononononono, bad! Bad marker! You stay alive while I’m spreading your guts out all over the board! That is an order!
lines.zh: : 不不不不不，不行！坏马克笔！我要把你的内脏涂满整块板子，你给我活着！这是命令！

lines.en: : Nodoka, I’m back. And I brought Sensei for some reason.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我回来了。不知道为什么把 Sensei 也带来了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard3
: Why the fuck are you here?! Can’t you see I’m working?! Can’t you see?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈来这儿干嘛？！没看见我在工作吗？！没看见吗？！

lines.en: : Where are your pants?
lines.zh: : 你的裤子呢？

lines.en: : Pants??? Those things??? They inhibit the movement of my legs. Of course I’m not wearing pants. Why would anyone wear pants???
lines.zh: : 裤子？？？那玩意儿？？？它会妨碍我腿的活动。我当然没穿裤子。谁会穿裤子啊？？？

lines.en: : Get the fuck out of my room if you’re just going to talk about pants. Or help me. Yes, help me. I could use the help. Just don’t mention pants again.
lines.zh: : 你要是只想聊裤子，就他妈滚出我的房间。要么就帮我。对，帮我。我需要人帮忙。就是别再提裤子了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard4
: What do you need help with, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你需要帮什么忙，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Something grey. And edible. I need you to find this. Find an item like that for me. Bring it to me. I need to look at it. It’s extremely FUCKING important.
lines.zh: : 灰色的东西。还能吃。我要你去找。给我找一个那样的东西。拿来给我。我得看看它。这事他妈的重要极了。

lines.en: : Nodoka, what are you writing on your board right now?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你现在在板上写什么呢？

lines.en: : Secrets. Secrets, secrets, secrets. For me to know and you to find out.
lines.zh: : 秘密。秘密、秘密、秘密。我知道，你们去猜。

lines.en: : The only problem is I DON’T FUCKING KNOW THEM EITHER. Get me something grey. Go. Shoo. Fetch.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是我他妈也不知道。给我拿点灰色的东西来。去。去去去。捡回来。

lines.en: : I can’t think of anything grey and edible off the top off my head, so I’m going to take Sensei over to my side of the room and-
lines.zh: : 我一时想不出什么灰色又能吃的东西，所以我打算把 Sensei 带到我那半边房间去-

lines.en: : No. Bad. Bring him here. I need to see something. I need to stare at something. I need to stare into something so I can see it. And I can’t see him from all the way over here.
lines.zh: : 不行。不行。把他带过来。我得看着点什么。我得盯着点什么。我得把目光探进什么东西里才能看见它。他在那么远我看不清。

lines.en: : Quickly. The marker is dying. It is the last one. The last one before a new one. You don’t want the new one. The new one is bad.
lines.zh: : 快点。马克笔快没水了。就剩这一支了。换新笔之前的最后一支。你不会想要那支新笔的。新笔不好。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard5
: Uhh...have fun? I’ll be at my desk.
lines.zh: : 呃……祝你玩得开心？我去我桌子那边了。

lines.en: scene black
I stare through Nodoka, trying to piece together the words haphazardly scribbled all over her dry erase board, but nothing comes to mind.
lines.zh: 我的目光穿过 Nodoka，试图拼凑出她那块白板上乱涂乱写的字，可什么头绪都没有。

lines.en: Carefully, I step over all of the things she’s pushed off of her desk and make my way over to her.
lines.zh: 我小心翼翼地跨过她从桌上推下来的所有东西，朝她走过去。

lines.en: The carpet is damp from spilled cups of old coffee and makes an interesting squishing noise the closer I get to the desk.
lines.zh: 地毯被洒出来的隔夜咖啡浸湿了，越靠近桌子，就发出越有意思的吧唧声。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard6
It was hard to notice from halfway across the room, but both her head and hands are shaking rather violently and her skin is an even paler shade of white than normal.
lines.zh: 隔着半个房间很难看出来，但她的头和手都在剧烈地抖，皮肤也比平时更苍白。

lines.en: She locks eyes with me, pupils transitioning to colorlessness, and doesn’t say a word for roughly twenty seconds.
lines.zh: 她与我四目相对，瞳孔渐渐失去颜色，大约有二十秒一个字也没说。

lines.en: In the background, I can hear Otoha logging into her computer, followed by the sound of keys on a keyboard being pressed down.
lines.zh: 背景里，我能听见 Otoha 登录电脑的声音，接着是键盘按键被按下的声音。

lines.en: Everything becomes apparent all at once.
lines.zh: 一切瞬间明朗起来。

lines.en: Everything except why I’m here in front of Nodoka.
lines.zh: 除了我为什么站在 Nodoka 面前这件事。

lines.en: : They’re the same as hers.
lines.zh: : 它们和她的一样。

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Deep. Black. Everything and nothing, shaped into a tiny little circle you can fit in your mouth.
lines.zh: : 深邃。漆黑。万物与虚无，被塑成一个能放进嘴里的黑色小圆。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes. But...no. Wait. What? I thought I understood, but I don’t understand anything. Come closer.
lines.zh: : 对。对。可是……不对。等等。什么？我以为我懂了，其实我什么都不懂。靠近点。

lines.en: : But I don’t-
lines.zh: : 可是我不-

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard7
: A girl with blue eyes. She came to me in a dream.
lines.zh: : 一个蓝眼睛的女孩。她在梦里来到我面前。

lines.en: : She opened up her palm and showed me what she was holding. It was a little toy car.
lines.zh: : 她张开手掌，给我看她拿着的东西。是一辆小玩具车。

lines.en: : Her mouth opened thereafter and she swallowed it like it was a pill. She washed it down with a glass of orange juice.
lines.zh: : 然后她张开嘴，像吞药片一样把它吞了下去。又用一杯橙汁送了下去。

lines.en: : I can picture it driving around in the caves of her intestines- stopping at stomach ulcers to refill its gas tank before continuing on with its journey.
lines.zh: : 我能想象它在她肠子的洞穴里开来开去-停在胃溃疡那儿加满油，再继续它的旅程。

lines.en: : What else resembles intestines, Sensei? List all of the long, tubular objects you know.
lines.zh: : 还有什么东西像肠子，Sensei？把所有你知道的长条管状物都列出来。

lines.en: I list some things.
lines.zh: 我列了几样。

lines.en: : Do you think I am something to love?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我值得被爱吗？

lines.en: : Do you think I am anything like her?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我像她吗？

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 我想了想。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard8
The world turns into a negative thing and my hands begin to feel kind of like the tongue of a clam but with more glass and less sand.
lines.zh: 世界变成了一片负片，我的手开始有点像蛤蜊的舌头，只不过玻璃更多、沙子更少。

lines.en: I approach the girl who isn’t the other girl and get ready to raise my affection points with her.
lines.zh: 我走向那个不是另一个女孩的女孩，准备提升她的好感度。

lines.en: I wonder how many living things there are inside of us right now.
lines.zh: 我在想，此刻我们体内究竟有多少活物。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard9
: What did Nodoka want? Couldn’t really hear whatever was going on over there on account of all the whispering.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 想要什么？那边一直在说悄悄话，我实在听不清发生了什么。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也不太确定。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess I can’t fault you for not understanding her when she’s...in that state.
lines.zh: : 也是。她……那个状态的时候，你听不懂也不能怪你。

lines.en: : Seems quieter now, though. So whatever you two talked about must have helped in some way.
lines.zh: : 不过现在好像安静多了。所以你们聊的那些总归起了点作用。

lines.en: : Now, I just have to figure out how to help {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在，我得想办法帮帮{i}你{/i}了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard10
: Me? What do I need help with?
lines.zh: : 我？我有什么需要帮忙的？

lines.en: : Well, judging by the mass amount of notebooks spread out all over your desk, I assume you’re having your own little bout of mania. Albeit one significantly less interesting than Nodoka’s.
lines.zh: : 嗯，看你桌上摊着的那一大堆笔记本，我猜你也有自己的小躁狂期。虽然比 Nodoka 的无聊多了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard11
: Oh...hahah. Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 哦……哈哈。对。那个啊。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m not really sure if I’d call it {i}mania{/i}...but I’ve been getting my ass kicked by some song I’ve been trying to write lately.
lines.zh: : 呃……我也不确定能不能叫{i}躁狂{/i}……只是最近被一首想写的歌折磨得够呛。

lines.en: : What are you writing about?
lines.zh: : 你想写什么？

lines.en: : Do you think I’d have this many notebooks out if I had any idea what the answer to that question was?
lines.zh: : 要是我知道这个问题的答案，你觉得我还会摊这么多笔记本吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea. I’m not really familiar with your...creative process.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我不太了解你的……创作流程。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard12
: Okay. So, like...every notebook serves its own purpose. I keep them organized by a combination of genre, lyrical style, and the mood or tone of whatever the song I’m writing is.
lines.zh: : 好吧。就是……每本笔记本都有自己的用途。我按曲风、歌词风格，还有我正在写的那首歌的情绪或调性来分门别类。

lines.en: : But, sometimes, when I can’t figure out what I’m trying to say, I have to hop between notebooks.
lines.zh: : 但有时候，当我想不出自己到底要表达什么，就只能在笔记本之间跳来跳去。

lines.en: : You know you could just invest in those divider things, right? That way, you wouldn’t have to use a different notebook for literally everything you do.
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以买那种分隔页的吧？这样就不用做每件事都换一本笔记本了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard13
: Uh-huh. But then I’d also have to keep track of all of the dividers on top of all of the notebooks and that just sounds like too much of a hassle.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。可那样我就得在记笔记本之外还得记那些分隔页，光是想想就太麻烦了。

lines.en: : I mean, the whole point of getting dividers would be to get rid of the notebooks.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，买分隔页的本来目的就是把笔记本都扔掉啊。

lines.en: : I hear you, and I’m glad you’re trying to help out, but there’s kind of a way I need to do things and I don’t really intend to change that any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我听懂了，也谢谢你帮忙出主意，不过我有我做事的方式，短期内也不打算改。

lines.en: : I just think that-
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得-

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard14
: Back the fuck off! I’m not going to-
lines.zh: : 给我他妈退开！我才不会-

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard15
: Mm!
: Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry. I didn’t mean to yell.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉。我不是故意冲你吼的。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard16
: I’ve just been under a lot of stress lately...trying to balance everything out and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我最近压力有点大……想把所有事都平衡好之类的。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m hoping I can at least get this song right since everything else has been turning to shit. It’s nothing against you.
lines.zh: : 所以既然别的事全都在往糟里走，我至少希望能把这首歌写好。这不是冲你。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Everyone gets overwhelmed from time to time.
lines.zh: : 没关系。谁都会有被压垮的时候。

lines.en: : Don’t you think it might be best to focus on something a little more serious if you’re just trying to make {i}one{/i} thing right, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你只是想把{i}一件{/i}事做好，是不是该把精力放在更重要的地方？

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard17
: Oh, come on. I thought we weren’t going to talk about her?
lines.zh: : 哦拜托。我们不是说好不聊她了吗？

lines.en: : If your organizational skills were a little better, we probably weren’t.
lines.zh: : 要是你的收纳能力强一点，我们大概确实不用聊。

lines.en: : Dude, come on. I’m trying to write a song {i}for{/i} Rin. That’s why my shit is everywhere. I can’t risk fucking this up too.
lines.zh: : 老兄，拜托。我是在试着写一首{i}给{/i}Rin 的歌。所以我的东西才到处都是。这事儿我也不能搞砸啊。

lines.en: : Am I going a little overboard? Sure. But it’ll pay out in the long run.
lines.zh: : 我是不是有点过头了？是。但长远来看会有回报的。

lines.en: : I’ve got no problem killing myself like this so long as I’m able to get my point across.
lines.zh: : 只要能把我想说的表达出来，把自己累成这样我也无所谓。

lines.en: : And what is your point, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你到底想表达什么？

lines.en: : No clue. See: desk.
lines.zh: : 毫无头绪。看：桌子。

lines.en: : If I can just come up with like, a clear message or a clear point I want to get across...I can avoid having to blindly throw darts at a dart board like this.
lines.zh: : 只要我能想出一个明确的信息或者明确的主旨……就不用像这样蒙着眼睛往飞镖盘上扔飞镖了。

lines.en: : I’m starting to understand why you’re so unfazed by Nodoka’s apparent psychotic breaks.
lines.zh: : 我开始明白你为什么对 Nodoka 那明显的精神崩溃这么无动于衷了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard18
: Oh, please. Me overworking myself is {i}way{/i} different from whatever the hell is going on in Nodoka’s super-brain.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我过度劳累跟 Nodoka 那个超级大脑里发生的事{i}完全{/i}不是一回事。

lines.en: : I’ve got this under control, man. It’ll all be worth it in the long run.
lines.zh: : 我心里有数，老兄。长远来看都值得。

lines.en: : Famous last words, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这话可是经典的临终遗言啊，Otoha。

lines.en: : What? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Just that you should know more about the dangers of what you’re doing. Plenty of people have thought the same way only to end up in boxes.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，你该多了解了解你正在做的事有多危险。很多人也这么想过，最后都进了棺材。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard19
: You’re worrying about the wrong person, Sensei. I’ve got way too much shit to do. I don’t have time to die.
lines.zh: : 你担心错人了，Sensei。我有太多事要做。我没时间死。

lines.en: : Well, I hope that’s true. Because I kind of like you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望如此。因为我挺喜欢你的。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard20
: And I mean that in the least creepy way possible.
lines.zh: : 我这么说已经是尽可能不猥琐了。

lines.en: : Yeah. That didn’t sound creepy at all that time. That’s why I probably look so shocked.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这次听起来一点都不猥琐。所以我大概才这么震惊。

lines.en: : Like, it sounded like you actually being a decent person for once.
lines.zh: : 就是……听起来像是你难得当了一回正经人。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what to say.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道该说什么。

lines.en: : You can say you like me too. Nodoka is too out of it to remember, so it will be like no one ever heard anything.
lines.zh: : 你也可以说你喜欢我啊。Nodoka 神志不清，记不住的，就当没人听见好了。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard21
: I don’t...{i}not{/i} like you.
lines.zh: : 我不……{i}不{/i}喜欢你。

lines.en: : I’ll take the double negative. I know what it really means.
lines.zh: : 双重否定我也接受。我知道它到底是什么意思。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard22
: You know...I know we’ve joked about it before. But today, you really {i}have{/i} felt kind of like an older brother or something to me.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我们以前是拿这个开过玩笑。但今天，你真的{i}有{/i}点像个哥哥之类的。

lines.en: : Annoying, yeah. And way too close to my personal space. But mostly full of advice and actually like, genuinely looking out for me. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 烦人，没错。还老是离我太近。但大部分时候都在给我建议，而且是真的、真心在为我着想。算是吧。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are some horrible intentions mixed in that are the cause of that, but I’m going to ignore them for the time being since it’s actually been pretty nice so far.
lines.zh: : 我肯定这里面混杂着一些可怕的企图，不过到目前为止感觉还不错，我就先忽略它们了。

lines.en: : I always wanted someone like that. Someone to kind of...counterbalance how suffocated I always felt by my parents. Someone who would, at the very least, understand that...
lines.zh: : 我一直想要这样一个人。一个能稍稍……抵消我父母带给我的窒息感的人。一个至少能理解这一点的人……

lines.en: : And I’m not saying you do just yet.. But you’re closer to it than most people. That’s nice.
lines.zh: : 我不是说你已经做到了。但你比大多数人都更接近。这就挺好的。

lines.en: I’m glad she’s able to look past my “horrible intentions,” because the way Otoha is blushing right now is certainly reinforcing them.
lines.zh: 很高兴她能无视我的“可怕企图”，因为 Otoha 此刻脸红的样子无疑在坐实它们。

lines.en: It’s no time to dwell on the sexual fantasies of a surrogate little sister, though. Not when it’s becoming clear that whatever hinges keep Otoha functional are slowly coming unscrewed.
lines.zh: 不过现在不是沉溺于对代理妹妹的性幻想的时候。尤其是当支撑 Otoha 正常运转的那些合页正在一颗颗松掉的时候。

lines.en: It’s possible you might be thinking that {i}I’m{/i} thinking too deeply into this, but I’d like you to consider the countless other cases in which creative minds rotted from the inside out in pursuit of...anything.
lines.zh: 你可能会觉得{i}我{/i}想太多了，但请你想想，有多少创造型头脑在追求……随便什么的过程中从内到外烂掉。

lines.en: There’s that old saying “A mind is a terrible thing to waste.”
lines.zh: 有句老话说：“浪费一个头脑是件可怕的事。”

lines.en: But, if that’s the case- why do we waste so many?
lines.zh: 可既然如此-为什么我们还要浪费这么多？

lines.en: And why is the beauty created by those minds only truly appreciated once they’re lowered into the soil?
lines.zh: 为什么那些头脑创造出的美，只有被埋进土里之后才真正被人欣赏？

lines.en: Some things can be beautiful above ground.
lines.zh: 有些东西在地面上也可以是美的。

lines.en: Before me is one of them.
lines.zh: 我面前的就是一个。

lines.en: : Just take it easy. Don’t get lost in whatever you’re doing and I’m sure everything will turn out...okay-ish.
lines.zh: : 放轻松点。别陷进你在做的事里出不来，我相信一切都会……还行吧。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard23
: Okay-ish is all I ask. So thanks.
lines.zh: : 还行就够了。谢了。

lines.en: : Also, if you ever want to call me “Big bro” or “Onii-chan” I am more than okay with it.
lines.zh: : 还有，你要是愿意叫我“大哥”或者“Onii-chan”，我是举双手赞成的。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 我考虑考虑。

lines.en: : That’s honestly more than I thought I would get. So thank {i}you{/i}, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这已经比我预想的多太多了。所以谢{i}你{/i}了，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohaworkshard24
: No problem, man. Just don’t go snooping around in my closet and always knock before coming into the room. We’ve gotta set some ground rules if we really want this to work out.
lines.zh: : 不客气，老兄。只是别乱翻我的衣柜，进房间前也一定要敲门。真想让这事儿成立，就得先定几条规矩。

lines.en: : I think this is the part where I tell some joke about having to check your closet to make sure you’re growing properly.
lines.zh: : 我想这时候我该讲个笑话，说我要检查你的衣柜，确认你发育正常。

lines.en: : Rad. Cause that means it’s also the time for me to punch you in the face and send you flying into orbit.
lines.zh: : 酷。因为这也意味着是时候我一拳打在你脸上，把你送上轨道了。

lines.en: : At least I’ll die happy.
lines.zh: : 至少我会死得很开心。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and I spend the next hour or so hanging out in her room, swapping back and forth between casual conversation and observing her roommate’s manic episode.
lines.zh: 接下来的一个小时左右，我和 Otoha 待在她房间里，在闲聊和旁观她室友的躁狂发作之间来回切换。

lines.en: And while I’d like to say that I’m glad she used this opportunity to take her mind off of working, I caught her jotting several things into several notebooks while we waited for night to come.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想说她抓住机会把心思从工作上挪开了，但我们在等天黑的时候，我好几次逮到她往好几个本子里记东西。

lines.en: I guess some people just can’t stop even when you make it incredibly apparent that they should.
lines.zh: 我想有些人就是停不下来，哪怕你明摆着告诉他们该停了。

lines.en: More power to her, I guess.
lines.zh: 算她厉害吧，我想。

lines.en: If Otoha thinks she’s able to just avoid being overwhelmed for the rest of eternity, she has every right to try and prove that.
lines.zh: 如果 Otoha 觉得自己可以永远不被压垮，她完全有权利去试着证明。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 不过-

lines.en: That also gives us (Or just me, I guess) the right to tell her “I told you so” when she can’t do it anymore.
lines.zh: 这也给了我们（大概只有我吧）在她撑不下去的时候说“我早就说过”的权利。

lines.en: That day will most assuredly come. And, when it does, I’ll be somewhere beside her.
lines.zh: 那一天迟早会来。到那时，我会在她身边的某个地方。

lines.en: Close, but not too close.
lines.zh: 离得近，但也不太近。

lines.en: Probably going through her closet.
lines.zh: 大概在翻她的衣柜。

lines.en: : Oh. Niki’s choreography thing just ended. She wants to know if we’re ready to head over to the restaurant yet.
lines.zh: : 哦。Niki 的编舞课刚结束。她问我们准备好去餐厅了没。

lines.en: : Is that what we’re doing? I remember agreeing to the double date thing, but I didn’t know we already chose a place.
lines.zh: : 我们要去那儿吗？我记得是答应了四人约会，但不知道已经选好地方了。

lines.en: : I guess so. It’s close-ish to the cafe, too, so Rin can probably come straight over after getting out of work in an hour.
lines.zh: : 应该是吧。离咖啡馆也挺近，Rin 一个小时后下班应该能直接过来。

lines.en: : Are you going to be able to stay away from your ten thousand notebooks for the rest of the night?
lines.zh: : 今晚剩下的时间你能离你那一万本笔记本远点吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve got a pocket-sized one that I keep on me at all times in case inspiration strikes while my babies are away.
lines.zh: : 能。我随身带了个口袋本，万一我的宝贝们不在身边时灵感来了呢。

lines.en: : You have a problem, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 你这是有病啊，Otoha。

lines.en: : Don’t we all, man? Don’t we all...
lines.zh: : 谁不是呢，老兄？谁不是呢……

$ otoha_love += 2

lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]!{/i}
